_comment: Rev 5 §13.2 golden set — ~20-25 representative questions with known-good expected answers, sourced by asking the real /ask endpoint against the live MAJU knowledge base (not invented) and recording what came back on 2026-09-05. Re-verify any entry manually if the underlying source content changes. English, Roman Urdu, and mixed are all represented, plus multi-turn sequences per §8.8.1 (elliptical follow-ups). Scoring is deliberately simple keyword containment, not RAGAS — per §13.2: 'the golden set is the valuable part, the tooling is secondary'.

cases.question: What is the fee structure for Bachelor programs?
What documents are required at the time of admission?
In which areas does MAJU offer degrees?
What is the attendance requirement to sit in the final exam?
How many credit hours are required to complete a BS program?
Is there a hostel or dormitory facility at MAJU?
What is the minimum CGPA required to avoid academic probation?
How can I contact the admissions office?
Fee kitni hai BS Computer Science ki?
Kya MAJU mein evening classes hoti hain?
What is the eligibility criteria for MS admission?
What is the last date to submit the admission form?

cases.notes: Standalone-then-elliptical-followup: second turn depends on the first turn's topic (§8.8.1) without repeating 'fee' or 'program' explicitly.

turns.question: What is the fee structure for Bachelor programs?

cases.notes: English opener, mixed-language elliptical follow-up — exercises both the follow-up retrieval path and the mixed-language reply path in one sequence.

turns.question: aur admission ke liye kya required hai
turns.notes: CGPA eligibility is sometimes summarized out of this broad follow-up (verified by re-running) — CNIC is the one document consistently present across repeat runs, so it's the stable regression signal for 'did the follow-up retrieve admission-requirement content at all'.
